what: Hovering the pill button grows the right margin from 60 → 72px over .5s so the button lengthens to the right, and the right star (icon) scales to 1.25x and rotates 180° (.5s). On leave the margin returns over .75s and the star slowly returns over 1s.

options.[data-fx-part=icon]: Star/arrow spinning in from the right (child)

from.where: shared.css .mr-button a — gold pill button + white star
